text:
indra_marketing: Quick alert — EU embedding requests showing 2-3x latency spikes since 07:05 UTC. Need statuspage copy + attendee comms for this morning's webinar.

mike_ops: Confirmed. Root cause looks like cache eviction storm on eu clusters. Mitigation scripted, rolling now. ETA 20-40m.

indra_marketing: Okay. Drafting status language; prefer concise and prescriptive. We must NOT send mass product email to Dedicated accounts with active escalations.

tara_support: We'll set auto-reply for incoming tickets and forward high-sev ones to EU pod. Proposed reply: "Thanks — we're aware of elevated latency for embeddings in EU. Engineers are mitigating; please include request_id and region (eu-west/eu-central). Use subject tag [priority-incident] for urgent items."

lucas_csm: For customers with booked demos/webinars in next 24h, CSMs should get a private note template, not the general blast. I'll coordinate outreach for accounts >$50k ARR.

amanda_sdr: Leads from the webinar sign-up flow should get a soft note: "We're experiencing temporary issues with embeddings in EU; demo may be affected — we'll update via status page." Tag leads with "impact-eu-embeddings" so SDRs can triage.

indra_marketing: Draft status copy — quick review please.

indra_marketing: ```
Incident: Embedded features in EU experiencing higher latency
Current status: Mitigating
Start time: 2026-03-21 07:05 UTC
Impact: Customers in eu-west and parts of eu-central may experience increased latency or timeouts for embedding requests.
Action underway: Engineers are applying mitigations to cache layer and routing traffic to healthy nodes. We will post updates every 15 minutes.
Guidance: Retry requests with exponential backoff. If you rely on near-real-time embeddings, consider switching to hosted alternate regions where feasible. Contact support with request IDs for priority handling.
```

mike_ops: LGTM. Add link placeholder to status page and change "Mitigating" to "Monitoring" once fully rolled.

indra_marketing: Agree. Plan: 1) Publish status, 2) Post short tweet/webhook to registrants linking status, 3) Send segmented emails(CSM-only for big accounts), 4) Tag leads and pause automated nurture for impacted cohort.

tara_support: Auto-reply live. Routing rule set to EU-pod and subject keyword added.

amanda_sdr: Lead tag rule active. Paused nurture for impacted list.

lucas_csm: CSM notification batch ready, holding until status is live.

statusbot: statuspage update posted by indra_marketing at 2026-03-21T07:28:45Z

indra_marketing: Published. Sending webinar registrant message in 3 minutes, linking status and offering recording/reschedule CTA.

mike_ops: Mitigation nearing completion; latencies trending down but not fully normal. Recommend wait for one more monitoring window before changing to Monitoring.

indra_marketing: noted. Will send registrant note now with link to status and reschedule CTA. Thanks all.
